runs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: 1024 x 1024 RGBA albedo texture-source painting of the Seedship, back view.

INPUT ROLES, IN THIS ORDER:
1. guide_back.png: EDIT TARGET and absolute authority for all geometry, silhouette, internal shape edges, openings, camera, scale, orientation and placement.
2. design_reference.png: REFERENCE for surface design, colours and materials only. Do not use its three-quarter camera, silhouette, framing or dramatic lighting.
3. concept_crop.png: supporting original-concept REFERENCE only.

PRIMARY REQUEST:
Paint the materials from the approved design reference directly onto the exact grey model shown in input 1. Return ONE square 1024 x 1024 image, with genuine alpha transparency, at its original canvas size. This is the back of the decoration as shown in the guide, not the reference camera. Preserve the guide pixel alignment. Keep its silhouette EXACTLY: every spine and its tip, every descending rib, notch, opening, lip and shape edge in the identical position. Do not add or remove any geometry. Do not mirror, rotate, change viewpoint, zoom, recenter, enlarge, crop, simplify or redesign the object. The guide object occupies approximately x=66..957, y=343..680 on its 1024 x 1024 canvas. Preserve the large empty transparent area above and below it. Its tallest hooked fin is at the RIGHT, curving leftward; its lower blunt prow is at the LEFT. This orientation and precise framing are mandatory.

MATERIAL PAINTING:
Dark violet-black resin hull; ivory bone ribs and plates with thin, fine gold-brown veins; rich amber-orange sac/opening interiors; ivory spines. Follow the reference's distinctive organic resin and bone materials, with fine surface details painted only inside the guide's existing geometry. Paint the broad raised ribs and the actual spines ivory with restrained gold-brown vein tracery; paint the recessed hull fields violet-black with amber-orange organic openings consistent with the approved design. Keep every raised rib, plate boundary and opening aligned to input 1. Do not transplant extra spines, perforations or protrusions from input 2. Preserve the guide's alpha silhouette, including the precise empty gaps between all spines and underneath the hull.

LIGHTING — STRICT ALBEDO:
Even, flat, shadowless light from the viewer across the whole surface. No cast shadows, no ambient-occlusion darkening, no strong specular highlights, no reflections, no rim light, no directional gradients, no vignette. The orange sacs and seams are painted at their glowing amber-orange colour, without light cast on surrounding bone/resin and without bloom or halo. Material colour is required, cinematic shading is forbidden.

BACKGROUND:
Fully transparent alpha outside the exact guide silhouette. No black painted background, no checkerboard painted into the image, no backdrop, no floor, no environment, no text, no labels, no watermark. Only the material-painted guide object. Preserve the target's original size and positions; return at 1024 x 1024 without rescaling.
